title: Second Annual International Book Fair in Minneapolis
body:
I attended the 2nd Annual International Book Fair in Minneapolis. The event was well attended and provided a valuable opportunity to engage with authors and explore their literary contributions..

.However, I felt that the time allocated for author discussions was insufficient. I would have appreciated more opportunities for meaningful conversations, particularly with Harun Maruf, author of Inside Al-Shabaab. Having read his book, I came prepared with several questions but unfortunately did not have the opportunity to ask them.

 For future events, I hope organizers will consider allowing more time for authors to engage with their audiences, as these discussions are among the most valuable aspects of a literary gathering.

title: Community safety gathering at Martiya
body:
I attended a community safety gathering hosted by Somali police officers at Martiya, an upscale Somali restaurant. It was my first visit, and I enjoyed meeting the owner.

 The gathering highlighted an important challenge: reaching parents who need support but are not attending these conversations. We need more direct outreach to ensure these families know that the community stands with them and is ready to help..
